many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def comps_c(g,bg):
    seen=[[False]*len(r) for r in g]; out=[]
    for i in range(len(g)):
        for j in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)];comp=[];seen[i][j]=True
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop();comp.append((a,b))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            x,y=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=x<len(g) and 0<=y<len(g[0]) and g[x][y]!=bg and not seen[x][y]:
                                seen[x][y]=True;st.append((x,y))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

def dominant_color(comp,g):
    cnt=Counter(g[r][c] for r,c in comp)
    return cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=comps_c(g,bg)
    # noise: single cells? recolor noise inside a comp to comp dominant color
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    comps.sort(key=lambda c:(min(r for r,_ in c), min(c_ for _,c_ in c)))
    placed=None  # list of (dr,dc) applied so far relative? We'll place sequentially, anchor first stays.
    for ci,c in enumerate(comps):
        if len(c)==1: continue  # skip singleton comps? handle later
        dom=dominant_color(c,g)
        # recolor every cell in comp to dominant color? demo5 comp2 had 6s recolored to 9; demo1 comp1 had 7s recolored to 2
        recolor=dom
        for r_,c_ in c:
            out[r_][c_]=recolor
        # determine translation to attach to placed cluster: bottom-align, then slide left until touch

def comps(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in g]; out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)];seen[i][j]=True;cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop();cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]!=bg and not seen[x][y]:
                            seen[x][y]=True;st.append((x,y))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

def solve(inp, out, allow_rot=False):
    g=inp; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    # recolor minorities within each comp to majority color
    objs=[]
    for c in cs:
        cnt=Counter(g[r][q] for r,q in c)
        maj=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        cells=[(r,q,maj) for r,q in c]
        objs.append(cells)
    # anchor: comp with smallest min col (then smallest min row)
    objs.sort(key=lambda o: (min(q for _,_,_ in o), min(r for r,_,_ in o)))
    anchor=objs[0]; placed=[anchor]
    others=objs[1:]
    outH,outW=len(out),len(out[0])
    occ=[[False]*outW for _ in range(outH)]
    for r,q,v in anchor: occ[r][q]=True
    # target shape: non-bg cells in output
    tgt={(r,q) for r in range(outH) for q in range(outW) if out[r][q]!=0}
    # collect per-object cell sets (relative coords) with majority recolor
    info=[[(r-min(r_ for r_,_,_ in o),q-min(q_ for _,q_ in o),v) for r,q,v in o] for o in objs]
    sols=[]
    def bt(i,used_cells=set()):
        if i==len(others):
            if used_cells==tgt and len(used_cells)==len(tgt): sols.append([list(o) for o in []])
            return True
        rel=info[i]
        res=[]
        # try translations
        rs=[r for r,_,_ in rel]; qs=[q for _,q,_ in rel]
        R0,R1=min(rs),max(rs); C0,C1=min(qs),max(qs)
        for dr in range(-R1,R1+1):
            for dc in range(-C1,C1+1):
                cur=[(r+dr,q+dc,v) for r,q,v in rel]
                if any(not(0<=r<outH and 0<=q<outW) for r,_,_ in cur): continue
                ps={(r,q) for r,q,_ in cur}
                if ps & used_cells: continue
                ok=True
                # must touch existing structure (adjacent orthogonally to any occupied cell)
                touch=False
                for r,q,_ in cur:
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        if (r+da,q+db) in used_cells: touch=True
                if not touch: continue
                res.append(ps)
        for ps in res:
            bt(i+1,used_cells|ps)
    bt(1,set())
    return sols

# sanity: try to match demo outputs allowing any translations, check consistency

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test Input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def get_comps(g,bg):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j));cells=[]
                while st:
                    cur_x,cur_y=st.pop();cells.append((cur_x,cur_y))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            if da==0 and db==0: continue
                            nx,ny=cur_x+da,cur_y+db
                            if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and g[nx][ny]!=bg and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                                seen.add((nx,ny));st.append((nx,ny))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
def solve(inp, go_shape=(None,None)):
    H_in=len(inp); W_in=len(inp[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r_ in inp for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    P=[]
    for cc in get_comps(inp,bg):
        ar=min(x for x,y in cc); ac=min(y for x,y in cc)
        P.append({'cells':cc,'ar':ar,'ac':ac,'size':len(cc),'colors':[(x-ar,y-ac,inp[x][y]) for x,y in cc]})
    # sort desc by size; largest stays anchored at (ar,ac)
    P.sort(key=lambda p:-p['size'])
    anchor=P[0]
    OV_H=anchor['ar']+max(a for a,b,_ in anchor['cells'] )+1
    OV_W=anchor['ac']+max(b for _,b,_ in anchor['cells'])+1
    OUT=[[bg]*OV_W for _ in range(OV_H)]
    occ=set()
    for a,b,c in anchor['cells']:
        OUT[anchor['ar']+a][anchor['ac']+b]=c; occ.add((anchor['ar']+a,anchor['ac']+b))
    # place rest by min manhattan, then lex (dr,dc)
    placed=[anchor]
    for pi in P[1:]:
        cands=[]
        rngR=max(a for a,b,_ in pi['cells'])+1
        rngC=max(b for _,b,_ in pi['cells'])+1
        for dr in range(-(OV_H-rngR), OV_H):
            for dc in range(-(OV_W-rngC), OV_W):
                rr=min(a for a,b,_ in pi['cells'])+dr
                if not(0<=rr<OV_H): continue
                # abs pos of each cell
                ok_all=True
                for a,b,c in pi['cells']:
                    R,C=pi['ar']+a+dr, pi['ac']+b+dc
                    if not(0<=R<OV_H and 0<=C<OV_W): ok_all=False;break
                    if (R,C) in occ: ok_all=False;break
                    if OUT[R][C]!=c: ok_all=False;break
                if not ok_all: continue
                touch=False
                for a,b,c in pi['cells']:
                    R,C=pi['ar']+a+dr, pi['ac']+b+dc
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            if (R+da,C+db) in occ: touch=True
                if touch:
                    cands.append((abs(dr)+abs(dc), dr, dc))
        if not cands: return None
        cands.sort()
        best=cands[0]
        for a,b,c in pi['cells']:
            R,C=pi['ar']+a+best[1], pi['ac']+b+best[2]
            OUT[R][C]=c; occ.add((R,C))
        placed.append(pi)
    return OUT

from collections import Counter
def comps4(g,bg):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j));cells=[]
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop();cells.append((x,y))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a2,b2=x+da,y+db
                        if 0<=a2<h and 0<=b2<w and g[a2][b2]!=bg and (a2,b2) not in seen:
                            seen.add((a2,b2));st.append((a2,b2))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

# Inspect the actual placement of each demo's components in output: find, for each input comp, its translated position.

    gi=G[nm+' input']; go=G[nm+' output']
    bg=Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=comps4(gi,bg)
    bgo=Counter(x for r_ in go for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    co=comps4(go,bgo)
    print('==',nm)
    for c in comps:
        cnt=Counter(gi[x][y] for x,y in c); maj=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        ar=min(x for x,y in c); ac=min(y for x,y in c)
        rel=[(x-ar,y-ac) for x,y in c]
        found=None
        for oc in co:
            oar=min(x for x,y in oc)
            orow=[(x-oar,y) for x,y in oc]

def try_place(P,Hin,Wsum,mode):
    OUT=[[0]*Wsum for _ in range(Hin)]; occ=set()
    for c in P:
        nc=normcells(c); maj=Counter(g[x][y] for x,y in c).most_common(1)[0][0]
        Rmax=max(a for a,b in nc); Cmax=max(b for _,b in nc)
        fits=[]
        for dr in range(Hin-Rmax):
            for dc in range(Wsum-Cmax):
                ok=True
                for a,b in nc:
                    if (dr+a,dc+b) in occ: ok=False;break
                if not ok: continue
                t=any((dr+a+da,dc+b+db) in occ for a,b in nc for da in(-1,0,1) for db in(-1,0,1) if (da or db))
                fits.append(((mode=='touch' and not t)*10**9, -(abs(dr)+abs(dc)), dr, dc))
        if not fits: return None
        fits.sort()
        dr,dc=fits[0][2],fits[0][3]
        for a,b in nc:
            OUT[dr+a][dc+b]=maj; occ.add((dr+a,dc+b))
    return OUT

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter
def comps_of(gi):
    seen=set();out=[]
    for i in range(len(gi)):
        for j in range(len(gi[0])):
            if gi[i][j]!=0 and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j));cells=[]
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop();cells.append((x,y))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            nx,ny=x+da,y+db
                            if 0<=nx<len(gi) and 0<=ny<len(gi[0]) and gi[nx][ny]!=0 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                                seen.add((nx,ny));st.append((nx,ny))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
# Clean inputs: recolor minority (noise) cells to majority within each component.
def clean(gi):
    g2=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for c in comps_of(gi):
        cnt=Counter(gi[x][y] for x,y in c)
        maj=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        for x,y in c: g2[x][y]=maj
    return g2

def clean(gi):
    g2=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for c in comps_of(gi):
        cnt=Counter(gi[x][y] for x,y in c)
        maj=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        for x,y in c: g2[x][y]=maj

for k_ in ['Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:

    g2=clean(gi)
    h=len(gi);w=len(gi[0])

    print(k_, 'outdims',(len(go),len(go[0])),'kept',len(keep))
    ocells={ (x,y):go[x][y] for x in range(len(go)) for y in range(len(go[0]))}

        # best single translation mapping all majcells into majority-color cells of output (allow extra out cells)

# Determine exact vertical deltas per mover (unique mapping to output cells).
def exact_delta(gi,go,mv,mcol):
    cands=[]
    for dr in range(-len(gi)-3,len(gi)+4):
        for dc in range(-len(gi[0])-3,len(gi[0])+4):
            tm={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in mv}
            if any(not(0<=r<len(go) and 0<=c<len(go[0])) for r,c in tm): continue
            if tm & {tuple(x) for x in []}: pass
            if all(go[r][c]==mcol for r,c in tm):
                # also need tm cells to have no other colors in go conflicting
                cands.append((dr,dc))
    return cands
for k_ in ['Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    gi=G[k_+' input']; go=G[k_+' output']
    g2=clean(gi)
    cs=comps_of(gi); cs.sort(key=lambda c:min(cc for _,cc in c))
    anchor=set(cs[0])
    print('===',k_)
    for mv in [set(tuple(x) for x in c) for c in cs[1:]]:
        mcol=g2[list(mv)[0][0]][list(mv)[0][1]]
        cd=exact_delta(gi,go,mv,mcol)
        cd=[d for d in cd if not ({(r+d[0],c+d[1]) for r,c in mv} & anchor)]
        cd.sort()
        # keep only those adjacent to anchor
        cd=[d for d in cd if any(abs(r-a)<=1 and abs(c-b)<=1 for r,c in {(r+d[0],c+d[1]) for r,c in mv} for a,b in anchor)]
        print('  mover sz',len(mv),'color',mcol,'valid:',cd[:6])
